models.label: Twee MX direct B32

config.purpose: hundred complete train-only epochs: joint weight-only MX quantization without truncation
config.weight_preprocess: original W32 G(W); detached mean(abs(W)), tanh/max normalization
config.mx_group_axis: flatten Cin*Kh*Kw within each Cout, zero-pad tail
config.mx_scale_policy: same power-3 frexp rule on current G(W) for both modes; independent direct encoding; scales equal for same W
config.mx_rounding: nearest ties-to-even; finite FP32 source, scalar subnormal flush, local subnormals supported
config.ste_policy: identity through each MX quantizer; retain original G(W) derivatives
config.numeric_kernel: FP32 F.conv2d; codec FP64 intermediates; not native low-bit kernels
config.loss: E2M3 hard CE + E2M1 upstream soft CE with detached E2M3 teacher; T=1; no division by 2
config.batchnorm_policy: two active weight-mode banks; legacy keys32/4 do NOT imply A32/A4; banks1/2/8 unused
config.initialization_policy: fresh seed20261009; same untrained state as prior model construction; no warmstart
config.evaluation_policy: both modes on complete official test after every epoch; hard CE for both
config.selection_policy: first strict maximum of E2M3/A32 official-test top1
config.reporting_policy: both modes from same selected best checkpoint; also both at final epoch
config.rng_policy: global streams as upstream; sequential dropout draws per mode; saved at epoch boundaries
config.checkpoint_policy: immutable FP32 training state per epoch and selected best/last copies
config.export_policy: independent direct E2M3 and E2M1 files per selected checkpoint; NOT one truncatable source

checkpoint_selection.policy: first strict maximum of E2M3/A32 official-test top1

models.layout_scope: existing packed MX export bytes hash-verified; proposed address placement simulated; no native accelerator run

models.label: Drie MX direct B32

config.purpose: 100 complete train-only epochs: joint direct E4M3/E2M3/E2M1 without weight truncation
config.weight_preprocess: original W32 G(W); detached mean(abs(W)), tanh/max normalization
config.activation_policy: original A32/ReLU in ALL THREE modes
config.mx_group_axis: flatten Cin*Kh*Kw within each Cout, zero-pad tail
config.mx_scale_policy: independent direct encoding of current G(W); E4M3 floor(log2(amax))-8; E2M3/E2M1 floor(log2(amax))-2; clip[-127,127], zero block exponent0; only E2 scales equal
config.mx_rounding: nearest ties-to-even; finite FP32 source, scalar subnormal flush, local subnormals supported
config.ste_policy: identity through each MX quantizer; retain original G(W) derivatives
config.numeric_kernel: FP32 F.conv2d; codec FP64 intermediates; not native low-bit kernels
config.quantization_source: same current FP32 G(W), independently per weight format
config.loss: E4M3 hard CE + E2M3 soft CE from detached E4M3 + E2M1 soft CE from detached E2M3; T=1; gradients summed, no division by 3
config.batchnorm_policy: three active weight-mode banks: E4M3=8, E2M3=32, E2M1=4; keys are storage IDs, all A32; banks1/2 unused
config.initialization_policy: fresh seed20261009; same untrained state as prior model construction; no warmstart
config.evaluation_policy: all three modes on complete official test after every epoch; hard CE for each
config.selection_policy: first strict maximum of E4M3/A32 official-test top1
config.reporting_policy: all three modes from same selected E4M3-best checkpoint and epoch100; incomplete runs also retain last completed epoch
config.rng_policy: global streams as upstream; sequential dropout draws per mode; saved at epoch boundaries
config.checkpoint_policy: immutable FP32 training state per epoch and selected best/last copies
config.export_policy: independent direct E4M3/E2M3/E2M1 files per selected checkpoint; not a truncatable source model

checkpoint_selection.policy: first strict maximum of E4M3/A32 official-test top1

models.label: Drie MX truncatie x64 B32

config.purpose: 100 complete train-only epochs: route B, E4M3 source, naive exponent truncation plus fixed scale64 to E2M3, then mantissa truncation to E2M1
config.weight_preprocess: original W32 G(W); detached mean(abs(W)), tanh/max normalization
config.activation_policy: original A32/ReLU in ALL THREE modes
config.mx_group_axis: flatten Cin*Kh*Kw within each Cout, zero-pad tail
config.mx_scale_policy: encode current E4M3 source scale floor(log2(amax))-8; clip[-127,127], zero block exponent0; both lower scale codes equal source code+6; integer promoted before addition; overflow above254 rejected without clipping/wrap, including zero blocks; source scales can change after optimizer steps
config.mx_rounding: E4M3 source nearest ties-to-even; finite FP32 source, scalar subnormal flush; lower modes exact bit mappings without additional rounding
config.ste_policy: identity wrt G(W) for E4M3 and complete scale64 E4-to-E2 code path; no extra factor64 in backward; retain original G(W) derivatives; no gradient through codes or scales
config.numeric_kernel: FP32 F.conv2d; codec FP64 intermediates; not native low-bit kernels
config.quantization_source: one current E4M3 encoding per MX layer and minibatch, shared across all three modes
config.exponent_mapping: s e3 e2 e1 e0 m2 m1 m0 -> s e3 e2 m2 m1 m0; target bias1; no bias compensation
config.mantissa_mapping: derived E2M3 uint8 codes >> 2; unchanged E2M3 scale equals original E4M3 scale times64
config.source_cache_policy: detached integer source and derived codes; one triplet per minibatch; cleared before Adam
config.loss: E4M3 hard CE + E2M3 soft CE from detached E4M3 + E2M1 soft CE from detached E2M3; T=1; gradients summed, no division by 3
config.batchnorm_policy: normal training updates of three mode banks E4M3=8,E2M3=32,E2M1=4; parameters and running stats learn per mode; eval frozen; keys are storage IDs, all A32; banks1/2 unused
config.initialization_policy: fresh seed20261009; same untrained state as prior model construction; no warmstart
config.evaluation_policy: all three modes on complete official test after every epoch; hard CE for each
config.selection_policy: first strict maximum of E4M3/A32 official-test top1
config.reporting_policy: all three modes from same selected E4M3-best checkpoint and epoch100; incomplete runs also retain last completed epoch
config.rng_policy: global streams as upstream; sequential dropout draws per mode; saved at epoch boundaries
config.checkpoint_policy: immutable FP32 training state per epoch and selected best/last copies
config.export_policy: one E4M3 source with all BN auxiliary state per selected checkpoint; lower exports derived only from saved/reloaded source codes and source scale code+6; separate FP32 resume checkpoint

checkpoint_selection.policy: first strict maximum of E4M3/A32 official-test top1
